author: packs
description: Nonprofit (X7-T1) for MENA charities: donors and households with giving totals and anonymous giving; funds by type (unrestricted, restricted, zakat, sadaqah, waqf, appeal); gifts and pledges against funds with yearly-numbered receipts; appeals; waqf assets and income distributions; beneficiary aid cases with eligibility and approval levels, kept apart from fundraisers by role; programmes. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.
name: nonprofit

definition.description: Manages donors, gifts, pledges and appeals; never sees aid cases.
definition.name: Fundraiser

definition.description: Assesses beneficiary aid cases; never sees donors.
definition.name: Caseworker

definition.description: Approves aid cases above the caseworker level.
definition.name: Aid Committee Member

definition.description: Owns funds, waqf assets and distributions.
definition.name: Finance Officer
Nonprofit: Giving by Fund This Year
definition.sql: SELECT fund_ref, COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM npo_gift WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND received_on >= date_trunc('year', NOW()) GROUP BY fund_ref ORDER BY amount DESC

target.query: Nonprofit: Giving by Fund This Year

definition.name: Nonprofit: Appeal Progress
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, goal_amount, raised_amount, ends_on FROM npo_appeal WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) ORDER BY ends_on

definition.name: Nonprofit: Aid Cases by Status
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cases, SUM(approved_amount) AS approved FROM npo_aid_case WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

title: Pack: nonprofit
